caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing figure on a square brown base. The figure has brown skin and long dark hair, and wears a headband with three green feathers. The attire consists of a red tunic with horizontal yellow and blue trim, yellow leggings, and black shoes. A prominent green sash is tied around the waist. The figure's right hand is extended forward holding a bundle of brown cylindrical objects, while the left hand rests on a vertical white post attached to the base. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Cigar Store Indian
